records.title: Tanakh (Hebrew Bible)
records.notes: Citations use Hebrew (Masoretic) chapter and verse numbering, which occasionally differs from English Bibles. Edition and translation to be confirmed during editorial review.

records.title: Old Testament
records.notes: The Christian Old Testament. Citations use the chapter and verse numbering common in English Bibles. Edition and translation to be confirmed during editorial review.

records.title: New Testament
records.notes: Citations use standard chapter and verse numbering. Edition and translation to be confirmed during editorial review.

records.title: Book of Tobit
records.notes: Part of the Catholic and Orthodox Old Testament; not part of the Jewish or Protestant canon. Edition and translation to be confirmed during editorial review.

records.title: 1 Enoch
records.notes: A Jewish apocalyptic work of the Second Temple period. Not part of the Hebrew Bible; canonical in the Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Church. Citations use the standard chapter and verse divisions. Edition and translation to be confirmed during editorial review.

records.title: War Scroll (1QM)
records.notes: A text among the Dead Sea Scrolls. Citations use column numbers. Edition and translation to be confirmed during editorial review.

records.title: Babylonian Talmud
records.notes: Citations use tractate and folio (daf) references. Edition and translation to be confirmed during editorial review.

records.title: Alphabet of Ben Sira
records.notes: A medieval Jewish work of satirical and legendary character; cited here as a source of folklore, not scripture. Edition and translation to be confirmed during editorial review.

records.title: Vulgate
records.notes: The Latin translation of the Bible associated with Jerome. Citations use standard chapter and verse numbering. Edition and translation to be confirmed during editorial review.

records.title: Niceno-Constantinopolitan Creed
records.notes: Creed associated with the Councils of Nicaea (325) and Constantinople (381). Edition and translation to be confirmed during editorial review.

records.title: The Celestial Hierarchy
records.author: Pseudo-Dionysius the Areopagite
records.notes: An early Christian theological treatise on the orders of angels. Edition and translation to be confirmed during editorial review.

records.title: The Qur'an
records.notes: Verse numbering follows the standard Cairo (1924) edition. Translation to be confirmed during editorial review.

records.title: Jami' at-Tirmidhi
records.notes: A canonical Sunni hadith collection. Citations identify the book (kitab), since hadith numbering varies between editions. Edition and translation to be confirmed during editorial review.

records.title: Rigveda
records.notes: Citations use mandala.hymn (sukta) or mandala.hymn.verse numbering. Edition and translation to be confirmed during editorial review.

records.title: Shvetashvatara Upanishad
records.notes: Citations use chapter.verse numbering. Edition and translation to be confirmed during editorial review.

records.title: Katha Upanishad
records.notes: Citations identify the chapter (adhyaya). Edition and translation to be confirmed during editorial review.

records.title: Bhagavad Gita
records.notes: Part of the Mahabharata (Bhishma Parva). Citations use chapter.verse numbering. Edition and translation to be confirmed during editorial review.

records.title: Mahabharata
records.notes: Citations identify the book (parva). Edition and translation to be confirmed during editorial review.

records.title: Ramayana of Valmiki
records.notes: Citations identify the book (kanda). Edition and translation to be confirmed during editorial review.

records.title: Devi Mahatmya (Markandeya Purana)
records.notes: Citations use the chapter numbering of the Devi Mahatmya's thirteen chapters. Edition and translation to be confirmed during editorial review.

records.title: Vishnu Purana
records.notes: Citations use book.chapter numbering. Edition and translation to be confirmed during editorial review.

records.title: Bhagavata Purana
records.notes: Citations use book (skandha).chapter numbering. Edition and translation to be confirmed during editorial review.

records.title: Shiva Purana
records.notes: Citations identify the samhita and section (khanda). Edition and translation to be confirmed during editorial review.
